readiness_decision: NOT READY FOR TRAINING (Native Ultralytics CutMix implementation limitation identified)
objective: Design a controlled experiment to evaluate whether rectangular patch augmentation and partial visibility improve detection on dense and overlapping waste scenes without degrading precision.

critical_implementation_limitation.mechanism: CutMix.get_params() calculates ioa1 = bbox_ioa(cut_areas, labels['instances'].bboxes) and strictly enforces idx = np.nonzero(ioa1.sum(axis=1) <= 0)[0]. If all num_areas (default 3) candidate cut rectangles intersect any existing bounding box in image 1, params['skip'] is set to True and CutMix is completely bypassed.
critical_implementation_limitation.empirical_skip_rate_in_multiobject_scene: 99.0% skip rate (99 out of 100 trials skipped on 3-object synthetic waste scenes)
critical_implementation_limitation.occlusion_failure: In the rare (<1%) cases where a cut area is accepted, it is strictly placed in empty background space with zero intersection with Image 1's bounding boxes. Consequently, primary objects in Image 1 are NEVER cut or partially occluded, and newly pasted instances from Image 2 do not overlap with existing instances.
critical_implementation_limitation.scientific_verdict: Native CutMix in Ultralytics 8.4.174 is structurally incapable of testing partial-visibility occlusion on primary objects or creating co-located overlapping object pairs. Passing cutmix > 0.0 results in a near-zero effective intervention rate and fails the core experimental hypothesis.

implementation_feasibility_audit.interaction_with_mosaic_and_mixup: CutMix is ordered after Mosaic and MixUp in v8_transforms. MixUp is held at 0.0 to isolate the intervention. CutMix uses pre_transform (Mosaic + Affine) when sampling secondary images.
implementation_feasibility_audit.close_mosaic_behavior: ultralytics/data/dataset.py:384-394 explicitly zeroes hyp.cutmix = 0.0 when close_mosaic=10 is triggered, actively disabling CutMix for epochs 91-100.
implementation_feasibility_audit.segmentation_mask_requirement: CutMix operates on bounding boxes and does not strictly require masks, but copy_paste does require polygon segments.
implementation_feasibility_audit.gpu_memory_estimate: 6.2 GB to 7.0 GB peak VRAM on RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (identical to E002/E003)

proposed_alternative_for_approval.mechanism: Albumentations CoarseDropout randomly erases rectangular patches within or across bounding boxes without altering box labels, forcing the detection head to identify objects under genuine rectangular partial occlusion.
proposed_alternative_for_approval.implementation_path: Supported natively in Ultralytics v8_transforms (line 2907: Albumentations(p=1.0, transforms=getattr(hyp, 'augmentations', None))) or as a custom pre-transform hook.

hypothesis: Dense waste scenes in SafaiOS validation suffer from missed detections on overlapping objects (16/18 false negatives in E002/E003). While MixUp blended full images transparently (disproven in E003), genuine rectangular patch occlusion (if properly implemented) forces the detector's deep feature pyramid to rely on partial local features rather than global unoccluded boundaries, thereby increasing overlap-stratum recall beyond 98.20% and reducing misses to <= 10.

criterion_1_overlap_recall.governing_protocol: Operational greedy bipartite matching (conf=0.25, NMS iou=0.60, match_iou=0.50) on pairwise ground-truth IoU >= 0.1 stratum

criterion_2_overlap_misses.governing_protocol: Operational greedy bipartite matching on pairwise ground-truth IoU >= 0.1 stratum

criterion_5_per_class_regression_guard.target: No per-class mAP@50-95 drop > 0.5 percentage points vs canonical E002
